title: Complete v1→v2 Transformation Map — CMA Part 1 Exam Simulator Certification Framework

section_1_board_changes.description: Consolidation from 8 operational boards (v1) to 5 boards (v2). Boards are consolidated governance entities that own distinct decision domains.

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: CAQS Dimensions 1 (Correctness), 3 (Technical Accuracy), 6 (Numerical Integrity), 7 (Explanation Quality). Owns PG-006, PG-009, Tier 1 numeric formula verification.
v1_to_v2_mapping.retained_authority: Accounting correctness, formula selection, independent recalculation
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Consolidated with EQS (both reviewed ExplanationCorrect); consolidated with Numerical Validation (both ran independent calculations)

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: CAQS Dimensions 2 (Precision), 4 (Distractor Quality), 5 (Blueprint Alignment). Owns PG-007 difficulty calibration, PG-AN-02 metadata completeness, DL-031 detection.
v1_to_v2_mapping.retained_authority: Distractor plausibility, distractor discrimination, answer-position balance, difficulty distribution
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Consolidated with Learner Safety (both reviewed distractor slot completeness); consolidated with UIQS (both reviewed choice rendering)

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Explanation quality, choice-specificity verification, distractor explanation uniqueness, DL-010 semantic review. Owns PG-002 (DL-010), PG-008 (EV3).
v1_to_v2_mapping.retained_authority: Explanation correctness, distractor explanation specificity, writing clarity
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Consolidated with DQS (both reviewed distractor content quality); consolidated with Technical Review (both reviewed ExplanationCorrect)

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 2 (content safety) + Governance Board (delivery pool gate)
v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Split: content-level safety (DL-008, DL-026, DL-030 detection) → Quality Board Agent 2 structural compliance. Delivery-pool safety (known-defective QID exclusion, pre-delivery check) → Governance Board Tier 3 (PORTFOLIO_READY).
v1_to_v2_mapping.retained_authority: Learner cannot see wrong-answer text in correct-answer slot; learner cannot see feedback about unrelated topics
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Split eliminates board that reviewed both content integrity and delivery integrity — separate concerns, separate boards

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 2 (structural compliance) + Governance Board (guard enforcement)
v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Split: structural compliance (field presence, type consistency, JSON integrity, DL-008/026/016/013 detection) → Quality Board Agent 2. Governance-guard enforcement (Rule 2 HARD_BLOCK, Rule 6 pre-flight gate, Rule 7 distractor completeness) → Governance Board.
v1_to_v2_mapping.retained_authority: Structural integrity enforcement; governance-guard rule execution
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Consolidated with Learner Safety (both detected DL-008); consolidated with Readiness (both checked pre-board state)

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Pre-session gate: all prerequisites met, baseline hashes verified, governance guard status confirmed. Post-session gate: all writes validated, backup protocol verified, no staged findings remaining, portfolio safe for learner delivery.
v1_to_v2_mapping.retained_authority: Session go/no-go decision; portfolio delivery authorization
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Consolidated with Launch Board (both checked pre-session state); consolidated with Archival Board (both checked post-session state)

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Rendering compliance per item, responsive layout verification, screen-reader compatibility, keyboard navigation. 95% unique scope — no other board touches UI rendering. Design Option E: recoverable standalone if rendering QA workload justifies separate agent.
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Standalone but optional — unique scope with no board overlap. Recoverable if v1 UIQS frequency (every other session) persists.

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Refocused: CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decisions only. No longer performs technical review, distractor review, or structural scanning — those are upstream board functions. Consumes Quality Board evidence + Pre-Flight Report. Produces Certification Decision Report (Report 3) and REVISION_HISTORY.md entries.
v1_to_v2_mapping.eliminated_redundancy: Stripped of scanning (→ Pre-Flight Scanner), stripped of content review (→ Quality Board), stripped of governance (→ Governance Board). Now does only what only it can do: the final CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE judgment.

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Canonical inventory management, compound key namespace, DELTA_LEDGER.json, MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md auto-generation, TemplateFamily classification, cross-pack QID collision detection, identity reconciliation (Gate 3). Single source of truth for 'which items exist and what are their identities.'
v1_to_v2_mapping.authority: Compound key uniqueness, registry integrity, delta ledger accuracy, TemplateFamily mapping
v1_to_v2_mapping.created_because: v1 had no identity authority — 8 disputes, ~12 phantom items, S320 variant misidentification, DL-029 75% false-positive rates. Registry Board is the structural answer to the identity problem.

v1_to_v2_mapping.v2_scope: Measures 10 BF metrics (agents/session, boards/session, reports/session, readiness failure rate, duplicate review cycles, re-review rate, identity ambiguity, cycle time, defect timing distribution, consumption rate). Produces Throughput Report appended to Governance & Audit Report (Report 4). NO decision authority — measurement and projection only.
v1_to_v2_mapping.authority: Measurement only. Cannot block sessions, cannot change state, cannot override other boards. Phase gate authority limited to HOLD_BACK recommendation (advisory).
v1_to_v2_mapping.created_because: v1 had zero accountability for the 72-agent, 8-board operational bloat. Board F provides measurement so the other 4 boards can self-correct. S202 Amendment 2 authorization.

v1_boards_retired: Launch Board (merged into Governance Board Tier 1)
Archival Board (merged into Governance Board Tier 2)
Forecast Board (merged into Throughput Board — measurement only, no forecasting authority)
Domain Specialist Board (domain expertise distributed to Quality Board per-section agent allocation)

v2_board_consolidation_summary.rationale: 8→4 consolidation target (D-03) with Throughput Board added per S202 Amendment 2.

section_2_gate_changes.description: v1's 8-gate pipeline (G1-G7 + Duplicate Prevention) → v2's 7-gate pipeline (Gate -1 through Gate 5). v2 adds pre-condition and pre-structural gates; v1 gates are absorbed into consolidated boards.

duplicate_prevention.v2_disposition: Absorbed into Registry Board — compound key collision detection (Gate 3 identity reconciliation). v1's QID-only duplicate check catches exact duplicates. v2's compound-key collision detection catches QID+CC+EW_Pattern duplicates from different packs.

G1_technical_review.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 1 (Technical & Explanation). Pre-Flight Gate 2 (PG-008 EV3 citation check) + Gate 4 (PG-006 CC verification). Board review is gated by pre-flight — board only sees structurally clean items.

G2_psychometric_review.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 2 (Psychometric & Safety). Pre-Flight Gate 4 (PG-007 DL-031 difficulty inflation). Board reviews difficulty calibration, Bloom's alignment, distractor quality on pre-flight-cleaned items.

G3_numerical_validation.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 1 (Technical & Explanation). Pre-Flight Gate 4 (PG-006 Tier 1 numeric formula verification). Independent recalculation is now a pre-board scan instead of a separate gate — gate result consumed by Technical reviewer.

G4_instructional_review.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 1 (Explanation quality) + Agent 2 (Distractor specificity). Pre-Flight Gate 2 (PG-003 DL-013 boilerplate, PG-008 EV3 principle citation). The EQS is now consumed as pre-flight evidence, not a separate board gate.

G5_metadata_review.v2_disposition: Quality Board, Agent 2 (Psychometric & Safety). Pre-Flight Gate 2 (PG-AN-02 metadata completeness). Metadata completeness is an automated scan; board reviews metadata quality (correct DifficultyScore mapping, appropriate CognitiveLevel).

G6_final_validation.v2_disposition: Governance Board — pre-write gate. Now executes as the Governance Board's pre-write / post-write gate checklist per AGENTS.md §13.3. All structural and content scans completed before this gate; this gate verifies nothing changed during board review (concurrent-write detection).

G7_certification_board.v2_disposition: Certification Board (refocused to CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE only). Board now receives Pre-Flight Report + Quality Board evidence. Decision types: CERTIFY (promote to Certified), HOLD (quarantine until conditions met), ESCALATE (route to human steward with specific question).

gate_minus_1.name: Identity Validation
gate_minus_1.description: Mandatory pre-condition (S202 Amendment 1). No downstream scan result is admissible until IDENTITY_VALID. Verifies QID presence/format, CorrectChoice presence/format, pack attribution, TemplateFamily constructibility. Compound key generated for every item.
gate_minus_1.v1_equivalent: NONE — this gate did not exist in v1. Items reached v1 boards with no identity verification.

gate_0.name: JSON Integrity
gate_0.description: Verify all pack and case files are parseable via AM-1 Function Constructor Parse, all required fields present, no corruption artifacts (DL-017), QuestionID counts match expected. Gate must pass before any downstream structural or content scan.
gate_0.v1_equivalent: Partial — v1 had no dedicated JSON integrity gate. Corruption (DL-017) was discovered at scan time, not gated.

gate_1.name: Structural Scan
gate_1.description: Detect field-level structural defects using within-object extraction: DL-008 (EW[CC] non-empty), EV8 (correct-answer slot empty), DL-026/DL-025/DL-021 (empty/absent non-CC EW slots), DL-016 (metadata-content Choice divergence).
gate_1.v1_equivalent: Distributed across Learner Safety + QA Review + EQS — no single structural gate existed.

gate_2.name: Content Quality Scan
gate_2.description: Detect content-quality defects in explanation text: DL-013 boilerplate (dual-phrase + Jaccard detection), EV3 missing principle citation, DL-010 suspected misassignment (Tier 1 lexical overlap). Does not HARD_BLOCK — SOFT_BLOCK and WARN only.
gate_2.v1_equivalent: Distributed across EQS + DQS + Learner Safety — no single content gate existed.

gate_3.name: Compound-Key Reconciliation
gate_3.description: Verify compound-key identity integrity across all packs. Detect duplicate compound keys, non-viable template families, cross-pack QID collisions, QID format violations. Confirm canonical seed viability in every template family.
gate_3.v1_equivalent: NONE — v1 had no compound-key identity concept. Cross-pack identity was managed ad-hoc by agents.

gate_4.name: Calculation Validation
gate_4.description: Verify answer-key correctness (DL-030) and difficulty calibration (DL-031). Three-tier CC detection: Tier 1 numeric formula verification, Tier 2 conceptual AI derivation, Tier 3 EC-CC consistency cross-check. Does not auto-change answers — SOFT_BLOCK routes to human expert review.
gate_4.v1_equivalent: Distributed across Technical Review + Numerical Validation + Psychometric — no single answer-key verification gate existed. DL-030 was discovered post-certification (Phase 0B), not pre-board.

gate_5.name: Certification Eligibility
gate_5.description: Synthesis gate — no new scans. Aggregates all gate verdicts (Gates -1 through 4) into READY / MINOR_FIX / REMEDIATE / BLOCKED classification per item. Produces Pre-Flight Report for board consumption. Computes readiness score (0-100).
gate_5.v1_equivalent: NONE — v1 had no readiness classification. Items reached boards with unknown defect inventory.

v1_vs_v2_gate_count.note: v1 had 7 content gates + Duplicate Prevention = 8. v2 has 5 scan gates + Gate -1 (pre-condition) + Gate 5 (synthesis) = 7. Two v2 gates (Gate -1, Gate 5) have no v1 equivalent.

section_3_state_model_changes.description: v1's 5-state model → v2's 9-state model. v2 adds pre-board states (PreFlight, ReadyForBoard, BoardReview), a delta state (CertifiedDelta), and a quarantine state (Hold).

Unprocessed.change: RETAINED — identical meaning. Item has not been processed by any certification pipeline.

In_Audit.change: REPLACED. v2 adds PreFlight and ReadyForBoard before BoardReview. 'In Audit' is now the BoardReview sub-state — item is actively being reviewed by a Quality Board agent. Preceded by ReadyForBoard (item has passed pre-flight and is queued for board review).

Editorial_Queue.change: RETAINED — identical meaning. Item requires structural or content revision before re-entering pipeline.

Certified.change: SPLIT. Certified: item passed full CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification. CertifiedDelta: item auto-inherited prior certification via hash match (IR-001) — no board review in current wave. Both are learner-pool-eligible. Governance distinction: CertifiedDelta items skipped board review and must be flagged for periodic deep-sampling (every 10th session, 5%).

Archived.change: RETAINED — identical meaning. Item removed from active pool, content preserved, compound key remains resolvable in registry.

PreFlight.description: Item is in the pre-flight scanning pipeline (Gates -1 through 4). Transitioned from Unprocessed or from Certified (re-scan trigger). Pre-flight is automated and machine-only — no human/board involvement. Readiness classification assigned on exit: READY, MINOR_FIX, REMEDIATE, or BLOCKED.

ReadyForBoard.description: Item has passed pre-flight with READY or MINOR_FIX classification. Queued for Quality Board review. Items are held here until the Session Arbiter allocates them to board members. MINOR_FIX items carry WARN annotations visible to the board.
exit_transitions: → CertifiedDelta (if delta review determines UNCHANGED + IR-001 conditions met → skip board)
ReadyForBoard.max_duration: 1 session (allocation must occur in same session as pre-flight)

BoardReview.description: Item is actively being reviewed by a Quality Board agent. Board member performs CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification on allocated items. Produces per-dimension scores and CERTIFIABLE / CERTIFIABLE_WITH_NOTES / NOT_CERTIFIABLE verdict.
entry_triggers: Allocated by Session Arbiter from ReadyForBoard queue
exit_transitions: → EditorialQueue (board verdict: NOT_CERTIFIABLE — specific remediation required)
→ Hold (board discovers CRITICAL defect not caught by pre-flight)

CertifiedDelta.v1_equivalent: NONE (v1 re-certified from scratch every wave)
CertifiedDelta.description: Item was previously Certified, delta review determined UNCHANGED (content hash matches, metadata hash matches, pre-flight re-verify PASS, primary_ledger_complete === true), and auto-inherited prior certification. No board review in current wave. Learner-pool-eligible (same as Certified). Governance distinction: CertifiedDelta items are flagged for periodic deep-sampling.
entry_triggers: IR-001 hash-match auto-inheritance (content unchanged → skip board)
exit_transitions: → PreFlight (triggered by periodic deep-sampling: every 10th session, 5% random sample)
State is stable — item remains CertifiedDelta until re-scan trigger
CertifiedDelta.max_duration: Unlimited (stable state, identical to Certified for delivery purposes)

Hold.v1_equivalent: NONE — v1 had no quarantine state
Hold.description: Item is quarantined from learner delivery pool. Used for: (a) items with confirmed CRITICAL defects discovered during BoardReview, (b) DL-016 cross-pack rotation artifacts (IR-005), (c) governance HARD_BLOCK items that require investigation. Hold must be time-bounded: resolution target 2 sessions. Hold items are hard-excluded from delivery pool.
entry_triggers: IR-005: DL-016 cross-pack rotation detected on Certified item
BoardReview discovers CRITICAL defect (DL-030 answer-key error, DL-010 confirmed misassignment)
Governance Board HOLD directive (e.g., concurrent-write affected items)
exit_transitions: → Certified (HOLD resolved — defect confirmed as non-material)
→ Archived (item determined to be unrecoverable clone or duplicate)
Hold.max_duration: 2 sessions (Governance Board escalation if unresolved at 2 sessions)

v1_transitions_replaced.v2: Unprocessed → PreFlight → ReadyForBoard → BoardReview (three intermediate gates replacing direct transition)
BoardReview → Certified (same destination, different source; pre-flight and readiness gates intervene)
Certified → PreFlight (re-scan triggered; if pre-flight PASS + hash match → CertifiedDelta; if pre-flight FAIL → ReadyForBoard → BoardReview)

v2_transitions_new: PreFlight → CertifiedDelta (delta inheritance — skip board, auto-inherit prior certification)
Any State → Hold (quarantine for critical defect investigation)
ReadyForBoard → CertifiedDelta (delta review overrides board allocation)

section_4_scan_methodology_changes.description: Scan methodology transformation from regex/forward-scan based detection to within-object extraction with compound-key identity.

v1_primary_methods: Flat field-name regex without object-boundary awareness
Totals-only defect reports without QID lists
v2_mandated_methods: AM-1 Function Constructor Parse — within-object extraction
v2_forbidden_methods: FM-001: Forward-scan regex for CC from QID anchor
FM-004: Flat field-name regex without object-boundary awareness
FM-005: Totals-only defect reports without QID lists
FM-006: Remediation script without pre/post defect cross-scan
FM-007: Agent self-report reliance without independent verification
FM-008: Session closure without CURRENT_BASELINES.md update

v1.scans: 22 historical scans across 6 sessions, ~80-110 total examinations
v1.method: Mixed — regex forward-scan from QID, some within-object (Session 700+), ExplanationValidator line-180 gap (fixed 2026-07-23)
v1.vulnerability: DL-029 vulnerable — forward-scan CC-offset produces ~25-75% false positives depending on pack field ordering
v1.governance: Governance-guard Rule 2 (BLOCK) — runtime enforcement at write time

v2.method: AM-1 within-object extraction. CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong[A-D] read from same brace-delimited object.
v2.false_positive_rate: 0% — 539 historical occurrences, every flag was genuine with within-object extraction
v2.governance: Governance-guard Rule 2 (BLOCK) upgraded to AM-1 parser; Rule 7 (Distractor Completeness) co-enforced
v2.co_detection: Co-detects DL-018 (absent EW[CC] field) and DL-026 (empty non-CC slots) in same pass
v2.gold_standard_test: Pack B must return 0 DL-008 — any scan returning >0 is non-compliant

v1.scans: Multiple boundary-aware scans across sessions; 5-agent scoping (632 items) vs Agent 6 independent verification (1,005 items) — 373-item discrepancy
v1.vulnerability: Count instability across scans (632 vs 1,005). DL-016 metadata-content mismatch causes false positives. Brace-matcher undercount (DL-020). Agent totals-only reports unverifiable.

v2.scans: PG-005 (Gate 1) — co-detected with DL-008 in same AM-1 pass
v2.method: Within-object extraction. For each item: iterate all 4 EW slots, compare against CC. Non-CC empty → DL-026. Non-CC absent → DL-021. CC non-empty → DL-008. Single pass, 3 defect classes.
v2.count_stability: Stable across 2 independent extraction passes per S725 §4.5
v2.governance: Governance-guard Rule 7 (Distractor Completeness — HARD_BLOCK) + Rule 2 co-enforcement

v1.scans: Multiple regex scans (DL-007 segmentation, DL-013 full-pool sweep, multiple remediation verification scans)
v1.method: Regex pattern matching across pack files. Boundary-aware QID-indexing established mid-cycle (2026-07-23).
v1.vulnerability: Brace-matched object parsing inflated unique QID count by ~15% (1,011 vs. correct 882). Window-based scanning produced false-positive Certified counts (9 items).

v2.method: Dual-phrase regex ('represents a plausible misconception' AND 'A candidate may select this option by misapplying') + Jaccard similarity between EW slot pairs (>80% → near-identical). DL-027 closing-tag variant detected by separate regex.

v1.scans: NONE pre-certification. DL-030 (5 answer-key errors) discovered post-certification by Phase 0B CorrectChoice Ground-Truth Audit (2026-07-23/24).
v1.method: Post-hoc independent derivation. 5 Certified items with wrong CC in learner pool until Phase 0B detection.
v1.impact: 5 items with wrong answers marked correct — HIGH learner-safety risk. Discovered 4 months after certification.

v2.method: Tier 1: Numeric formula verification against FORMULA_MASTER.md. Tier 2: Build-time AI conceptual derivation. Tier 3: EC-CC consistency cross-check (catches 3 of 5 known DL-030 errors).
v2.blocking: SOFT_BLOCK — cannot auto-change answer key. Items flagged REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW route to human expert. Zero CC errors reach certification board.

gold_standard_tests.description: Per S725 §6.2: every scan methodology must pass these calibration tests before operational use.

tests.test: Two independent runs: identical counts + QID lists
QID list included in every finding
tests.expected: Every defect report includes QID list

section_5_report_changes.description: v1 reporting: 1,227 files, 65% unconsumed, 9x metric duplication → v2: ≤4 standard reports per session, >90% consumption target.

v1_reporting_baseline.consumption_rate: 35% (432/1,227 files cross-referenced in REVISION_HISTORY.md or SESSION_SUMMARY.md)
v1_reporting_baseline.metric_duplication_ratio: 3.5:1 (15 core metrics appear across avg 5.3 files each)
v1_reporting_baseline.one_off_report_pct: 65% (files consumed in exactly 1 session, never referenced again)

v1_categories_retired.retirement: RETIRED — agent findings embedded into consolidated Quality Report (Report 2). Agent outputs are intermediate artifacts consumed by the board during the session, not persisted as permanent reports.
v1_categories_retired.content_preserved_in: Quality Board verdicts in Report 2 R2_PER_ITEM_VERDICT

v1_categories_retired.pattern: SESSION DASHBOARD, PORTFOLIO DASHBOARD, SECTION DASHBOARD
v1_categories_retired.count: ~80 files (session dashboards: ~50, portfolio dashboards: ~15, section dashboards: ~15)
v1_categories_retired.retirement: MERGED → Readiness Report (Report 1). Portfolio dashboard metrics consolidated to R1_PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT. Session dashboard metrics consolidated to R1_SESSION_PLAN. Section dashboards consolidated to domain_distribution within R1_PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT.
RETIRED — reporting consolidation eliminates the need for meta-reports. The 4-report model is self-documenting.
RETIRED — forecasts are Throughput Board measurement outputs, not standalone report files. Throughput data appended to Report 4 (R4 through BF-001..010 metrics).

RETIRED — authoring plans captured in Report 1 (R1_SESSION_PLAN.target_qids). Spec content that is reusable lives in S311 EW Factory standard. One-off specs consumed only within authoring session — no permanent retention value.
RETIRED — wave scope is Report 1 target_qids. Wave quality audit is Report 2. Wave certification is Report 3. Batch-specific artifacts retired after batch close.
v1_categories_retired.content_preserved_in: Reports 1-3 (distributed by wave scope, quality, certification)

report_1.name: Readiness Report
report_1.purpose: Pre-session and mid-session operational state. Session gate status, portfolio snapshot, session plan, mid-session drift check.

report_2.name: Quality Report
report_2.purpose: Per-item and aggregate quality assessment. Structural defect inventory, content quality scores, EW integrity, per-item CAQS dimension verdicts, difficulty distribution.
report_2.consumer_board: Quality Board (all 3 sub-agents) + Certification Board (evidence package)

report_3.name: Certification Decision Report
report_3.purpose: Per-item certification decisions with evidence trail. CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE per QID, state transitions applied, before/after certified counts, REVISION_HISTORY.md entry data.

report_4.name: Governance & Audit Report
report_4.purpose: Session governance attestation, portfolio authorization, and audit trail. Session close authorization, delivery pool safety, governance events, defect library updates, portfolio health index.

consumption_targets.enforcement: Every file in reports/ directory must have a defined downstream consumer board. Soft cap: 8 files per session. Hard cap: 4 files by S910. Files >8 require BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker with justification.

section_6_metric_changes.description: v1 metric duplication (15 core metrics across avg 5.3 files each) → v2 single-source architecture (each metric in ≤2 files).

authoritative_metric_assignments.v1_files: 6 files/session (~90 total appearances: EW_INTEGRITY_AUDIT, EW_AUDIT, EW_COVERAGE_AUDIT, LEARNER_SAFETY, QUALITY_GATE, STRUCTURAL_AUDIT)
4 files/session (~120 appearances: GOVERNANCE_PRESERVATION_AUDIT, SESSION_DASHBOARD, READINESS_BOARD, GOVERNANCE_REPORT)

metric_deduplication_principle.rule: No metric appears in more than 2 reports. Primary report owns the authoritative value. Secondary report references for context only, never duplicates computation.

section_7_agent_reduction.description: 72 unique agent types (S200 census) → consolidated v2 agent model. Reduction achieved through pre-flight automation, delta review, board consolidation, and reporting consolidation.

read_only_analysis.description: Scan, audit, and verification agents that examined items but produced no writes

verification.description: Independent re-verification agents that re-scanned after remediation

board.description: Content board agents (Technical, EQS, DQS, Learner Safety, QA, Readiness, Launch, Archival)

reporting.description: Report generation agents producing 65% one-off files

governance.description: Governance enforcement, sync, and attestation agents

categories.note: Categories overlap — agents could belong to multiple categories. Raw sum >72.

read_only_analysis_agents.v2_disposition: Eliminated by pre-flight automation. Gates -1 through 4 run 11 automated scans in ~8.5 minutes — replacing all manual scan agents. Scan-once/consume-many: one scan per gate, consumed by all downstream boards.

verification_agents.v2_disposition: Replaced by scan artifact consumption. PG-011 through PG-007 produce immutable CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACTs consumed by all downstream consumers. No re-verification needed — scan results are versioned and reproducible. Post-remediation verification replaced by pre/post gate re-run comparison.

board_agents.v2_disposition: Consolidated into Quality Board (3 sub-agents: Technical & Explanation, Psychometric & Safety, Structural/Safety). Retains 3 agent personas within 1 consolidated board + Certification Board (1 adjudication agent) + Registry Board (1 identity registry agent).

reporting_agents.v2_disposition: Consolidated into 4-report model. Each board generates its own report as a byproduct of its work. No standalone report-generation agents. Session Arbiter produces Report 1. Quality Board produces Report 2. Certification Board produces Report 3. Governance Board produces Report 4.

governance_agents.v2_disposition: Consolidated into Governance Board (Tier 1 SESSION_READY + Tier 2 SESSION_CLOSE + Tier 3 PORTFOLIO_READY). One board handles all governance functions that previously spanned 18 agent types.

v2_new_agents.description: New agent roles created to fill v1 gaps.

agents.purpose: Coordinates session execution. Runs pre-flight pipeline, produces Readiness Report, allocates items to board members, monitors mid-session drift, executes Tend reconciliation. Replaces the v1 pattern of 'Session Orchestrator + 3-5 governance agents per session.'
agents.replaces: Readiness Review Board + Launch Board + Archival Board + Session orchestrator agents

agents.purpose: Automated scan pipeline. Runs Gates -1 through 4, produces scan artifacts, classifies items (READY/MINOR_FIX/REMEDIATE/BLOCKED). Fully automated — no manual agent involvement. Runs in ~2 minutes for all 5 packs with parallel execution.
Manages compound key namespace, DELTA_LEDGER.json, MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md, TemplateFamily mapping, cross-pack QID collision detection. Single source of truth for item identity.

section_8_defect_class_coverage.description: Which v2 component addresses each known defect class from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md. This is the accountability matrix — every defect class must have a v2 gate or governance rule that detects it before certification.

coverage_matrix.description: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty — wrong text in correct-answer slot
coverage_matrix.v1_detection: 22 scans, 6 sessions, ~80-110 examinations, learner pool: 67 Certified remaining (SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24)

v2_coverage.role: Ensures CC extracted from correct object — prevents DL-029 false negatives
Within-object extraction detects all EW[CC] non-empty. 0% false-positive rate.
Runtime BLOCK at write time — prevents re-contamination

coverage_matrix.description: Misassigned choice explanations — ExplanationWrong text describes wrong choice
coverage_matrix.v1_detection: Post-hoc semantic scan (P1-A-029 prototype). No systematic detection. ~94% false-positive rate on automated lexical-overlap approach.

v2_coverage.role: Ensures EW fields compared against content-block Choices from same object — prevents DL-016 contamination of DL-010 detection
Tier 1 lexical overlap + Tier 2 numeric mismatch heuristic. WARN only — cannot HARD_BLOCK due to high FP rate.
Human/AI editorial review of WARN-flagged DL-010 items before certification

coverage_matrix.description: Section E clonal redundancy — 140 template clones with zero pedagogical differentiation
coverage_matrix.v1_detection: Section E population scan 2026-07-22. 3 scans before count stabilized at 140. Unremediated per SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24 §3.3.

v2_coverage.role: Jaccard stem clustering identifies rotation groups. Non-seed variants classified as clones. Clone archival rule prevents clone certification.
Identifies all 5-item rotation groups, selects canonical seed, marks clones. HARD_BLOCK: certified clones cannot exist.
Duplicate compound keys from clone groups detected as collisions

coverage_matrix.description: Template boilerplate distractor explanations — 'represents a plausible misconception' + 'A candidate may select this option by misapplying'
coverage_matrix.v1_detection: Multiple regex scans. 2,587 fields identified across 882 QIDs. 851 fields remaining in Packs A/C/D non-Certified sections.

v2_coverage.role: Dual-phrase regex + Jaccard between EW slot pairs. Automated per-session.
Template Boilerplate Prohibition — WARN at write time. Prevents new boilerplate insertion.

coverage_matrix.description: Metadata-block vs content-block Choice divergence — learners see feedback about wrong item's topic

section_9_implementation_dependencies.description: Nine decisions (D-01 through D-09) required before S202 implementation. Each decision includes recommended option, blocks-if-not-approved impact, and producing board.

decisions.title: Adopt Compound-Key Identity Model
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT as specified in SESSION202_IDENTITY_MODEL_V2.json — QID + CorrectChoice + EW_Pattern + Template_Family + File_Path + VersionID
blocks_if_not_approved: Gate -1 Identity Validation (Identity is the gate's only purpose)
Gate 3 Compound-Key Reconciliation (no compound keys to reconcile)
Registry Board (no identity namespace to manage)
Delta review (no stable identity for hash-to-hash comparison)
DL-016 remediation targeting (cannot distinguish metadata-vs-content block items by QID alone)
S320 variant disambiguation (cannot target correct variant in rotation group)
decisions.evidence: SESSION201_IDENTITY_ARCHITECTURE.json (Board 4), DL-029, S320, DL-016, 8 dispute cases, ~12 phantom items

decisions.title: Mandate AM-1 Function Constructor Parse
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT as the single approved extraction methodology. AM-2 (string-aware brace match) as fallback only.
blocks_if_not_approved: Gate 0 JSON Integrity (requires reliable parser)
Gateway -1 IDENTITY_VALID (requires CorrectChoice from same object as QID)
All structural scans (PG-001 through PG-005 — all require within-object extraction)
Pack B gold-standard test (DL-008 = 0 — only achievable with within-object extraction)
DL-029 elimination (forward-scan false positives persist without AM-1)
decisions.evidence: S726 Rule 2 Parse Spec, DL-029 (257 Pack B false positives with forward-scan), 0 false positives with AM-1

decisions.title: Approve 5-Board Consolidation Target
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT 5-board model: Registry, Quality (3 sub-agents), Governance (3 tiers), Certification, Throughput (measurement-only). Phase 1 at S830: 4 boards (Quality + Governance + Certification + Registry). Phase 2 at S900: add Throughput Board.
blocks_if_not_approved: Board consolidation (boards remain at 8 — no agent savings)
Reporting consolidation (4-report model assumes board consolidation)
Throughput measurement (Board F requires board-level accountability structure)
Agent reduction target (7-8 per wave unreachable without board consolidation)
decisions.evidence: S200: 72 agent types, 2.5:1 duplication. S201: Board 6 confirmed 4-board optimal. S202: Amendment 2 added Throughput as Board 5.

decisions.title: Commit to Delta Review with Phased Adoption
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT. Phase 1 (S202-S207): seed CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json for all 2,500 items. Phase 2 (S208+): operational delta review. Standard: SHA-256 content hashing, field-level diff, auto-inheritance per IR-001 through IR-005.
blocks_if_not_approved: Delta review (no hash baseline for comparison)
80% time savings on unchanged items (re-audit every item every wave persists)
S809→S810.1 pattern repeats (4 sessions, 60 agents, 0 writes, 1 novel finding)
Throughput Board BF-006 target (re-review rate <20% requires delta review)
decisions.evidence: S200: 80% unchanged, 77% time savings. S201: S809 chain — 60 spawns, 0 writes. S318: 75% redundant audits post-certification.

decisions.title: Approve Reporting Reduction Targets
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT 4-report model with soft cap at 8 files. Hard cap at 4 by S910. Phase-down schedule: S830 → 8 cap, S900 → enforced 8, S910 → hard 4.
blocks_if_not_approved: Reporting consolidation (1,227 files, 65% unconsumed persists)
Metric deduplication (15 metrics × 5.3 files average persists)
Agent reduction (21 reporting agents eliminated by 4-report model)
Consumption target >90% (unreachable without consolidation)
decisions.producing_board: Governance Board (S200 Agent G + S201 Board 5 analysis)
decisions.evidence: S200: 1,212 files, 65% one-off. S201: 1,227 files, 35% consumed, 3.5:1 metric duplication.

decisions.title: Authorize Session-Level File-Lock Protocol
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT. Before any pack-file write, acquire .lock file. Concurrent sessions detect lock and queue. Pre-write hash → write → post-write hash reconciliation at Tend (RT-011).
blocks_if_not_approved: DL-019 concurrent-write prevention (432 items lost in one incident)
DL-028 remediation regression prevention (~200 slots lost in one incident)
Delta review integrity (concurrent writes invalidate hash baselines)
Session isolation guarantee (required for multi-agent sessions per AGENTS.md §13)
decisions.evidence: DL-019: 432 items. DL-028: ~200 slots. Both occurred within 24-hour window 2026-07-23.

decisions.title: Mandate S311 EW Factory Standard
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT as the single standard for all new ExplanationWrong text authoring. Choice-specific, COSO-aligned, minimum 50 chars, must reference governing principle, must explain specific misconception.
blocks_if_not_approved: DL-013 boilerplate remediation (no standard replacement text format)
DL-026 empty-slot fills (no authoring standard to ensure quality)
Future item authoring (no template for consistent EW text across packs)
Quality Board Agent 2 review (no standard to judge against)
decisions.evidence: DL-013: 2,587 boilerplate fields across 882 QIDs. DL-026: 1,005 items with empty slots. S805: 57 Pack A Section E items successfully authored per S311 standard.

decisions.title: Add Gate -1 Identity Validation (S202 Amendment 1)
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT as mandatory pre-condition. No downstream scan result is admissible until IDENTITY_VALID. Per-item compound key generation.
blocks_if_not_approved: All structural scans require identity-valid items (PG-001 through PG-005 cannot trust CC extraction)
DL-029 false positives persist (forward-scan CC-offset uncatchable without identity gate)
DL-016 +1 shift contamination (scans run on wrong item's fields)
S320 variant misidentification (remediation targets wrong item in rotation group)
decisions.evidence: S320: 4 sessions, 60 agents, 0 effective writes — all CC-offset artifacts. DL-029: 257 Pack B false positives. DL-016: systematic +1 shift in Pack A/C/D dual-block items.

decisions.title: Add Board F — Throughput & Economics (S202 Amendment 2)
decisions.recommended_option: ADOPT with measurement-only authority. Board F tracks 10 BF metrics across T0 (S202), Tmid (S830), and Tend (S910) checkpoints. Produces throughput appendix in Report 4. No decision authority — measurement and projection only.
blocks_if_not_approved: No v1→v2 improvement quantification (v1 baseline, v2 targets, expected savings all conjecture without measurement)
Phase gate activation criteria unverified (PGC-001 through PGC-005 at S830, S900 require measured thresholds)
Investment ROI unproven (Phase 1: 6 sessions, ~54 spawns, ~200 items foregone — break-even at ~254 items unverifiable without Board F)
No rollback trigger (if v2 underperforms v1, no measurement exists to trigger reversion)
decisions.evidence: SESSION202_THROUGHPUT_MODEL.json: 16 v1 baseline metrics, 13 v2 target metrics, 10 BF tracked metrics, 5 phase gate criteria, 7 cost model datapoints.

section_10_risk_registry.description: Six migration risks from S201 Board 9 risk assessment with S202-specific mitigations. Each risk maps to a phase gate activation criterion.

risks.title: Novel Defect Classes Discovered During Transition
risks.description: Pack C/D Sections C-F are unaudited (~469 uncertified items). These sections may contain defect classes not catalogued in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md (DL-001 through DL-033). Novel defects would require pattern extension in pre-flight scans, extending Phase 1 by 2-3 sessions.
risks.v1_impact: DL-008 through DL-033 were all discovered reactively — none were known at project start. Each discovery triggered multi-session remediation chains.
s202_mitigation: Governance Board HOLD protocol: novel defects discovered during pre-flight → HOLD items, log new DL-ID to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md (per AGENTS.md §12), extend PG pattern library
Phase 0B pre-audit of Pack C/D Sections C-F before Phase 1 certification runs (recommended: S203-S205)
Pre-flight gate design is extensible: new PG-AN-0X scans can be added to existing gates without restructuring pipeline
Periodic deep-sampling (every 10th session, 5% random CertifiedDelta sample) catches novel defects that escape pre-flight patterns
risks.governance_trigger: PGC-003 assessment at S830: if pre-flight readiness failure rate >44.7% (insufficient improvement from v1 89.5%), Phase 2 HOLD_BACK. Novel defect discovery would inflate readiness failure rate.

risks.title: Hash Instability Across Sessions
risks.description: SHA-256 content hashes are deterministic for identical input, but: (a) different extraction tools may produce different canonical JSON serializations (whitespace, key ordering), (b) pack file encoding drift (BOM, line endings) may alter extracted strings, (c) concurrent-write noise may change content without changing meaningful fields.
risks.v1_impact: Not applicable — v1 had no content hashing.
s202_mitigation: Canonical JSON serialization standard: sorted keys, consistent whitespace normalization, no trailing commas, UTF-8, no BOM
Pre-write hash and post-read hash use identical extraction code (same Node.js script, same AM-1 parser)
Field-level hash manifest: if content_hash differs but ALL field_hashes match → methodology error (IR fallback: escalate to methodology audit)
Phase 1 initial seeding: independent re-extraction and re-hashing of all 2,500 items by two independent passes — 0 mismatches required before operational adoption
5% random sample cross-validation at Tend: manually extract fields from raw file, compute hash, compare to computed hash
Conservative scanner override: if pre-flight scan finds ANY structural defect on a hash-matching item → reclassify to CONTENT_CHANGED (IR-001 override)
risks.governance_trigger: If hash mismatch rate exceeds 5% of items claimed 'unchanged' → trigger methodology audit. If drift persists across 2+ sessions → escalate to human steward.

risks.title: Operational Fires Consuming Agent Capacity
risks.description: Real-world CMA exam content specification changes, application bugs, or governance emergencies may consume agent capacity planned for v2 transition work. Phase 1 could extend from 6 sessions to 8-10 sessions, delaying break-even and Phase 2 activation.
risks.v1_impact: Sessions S1-S800 were reactive to defect discoveries — each DL-008/013/026/030 finding triggered unscheduled remediation chains consuming 20-30 sessions.
s202_mitigation: Governance Board triage protocol: only CRITICAL fires consume Phase 1 capacity. HIGH fires queued for Phase 2. MEDIUM/LOW deferred to Phase 3.
D-06 file-lock protocol quarantines non-Phase-1 files from concurrent modification — prevents fire-induced overwrites during transition
Throughput Board BF-004 (readiness failure rate) monitoring: if rate exceeds 44.7% at S830, Phase 1 firefighting was insufficient — escalate to Governance Board for re-prioritization
Phase 1 is designed for minimum viable pre-flight: Gates -1, 0, 1 only. Gates 2-4 deferred to Phase 2 if capacity constrained.
risks.governance_trigger: If Phase 1 extends beyond S210 (4+ session overrun), Throughput Board reports deviation >200% of plan. Governance Board re-assesses timeline.

risks.title: Throughput Model Estimates Inaccurate
risks.description: v1 agent-spawn estimate is ±70 (620 ±70). v1→v2 savings projections are based on modeling, not operational measurement. Actual throughput improvements may be substantially lower or higher than 3.8× multiplier. Break-even at ~254 certified items may shift ±50 items.
risks.v1_impact: Not applicable — v1 had no throughput measurement.
s202_mitigation: Board F measurement protocol: 10 BF metrics tracked at T0 (S202), Tmid (S830), Tend (S910). No reliance on single-point estimates.
Rollback triggers: if BF-004 (readiness failure) not ≥50% improved by S830 → Phase 2 HOLD_BACK. If BF-008 (cycle time) not ≤2 sessions by S900 → Phase 3 HOLD_BACK.
Precise v1 agent-spawn enumeration at T0 (S202) before Phase 1 begins — reduces ±70 uncertainty to ±10
Adaptive targets: if actual throughput improvement diverges >20% from forecast, Board F recalibrates Phase 2/3 targets based on measured rates, not modeled estimates

Investment cap: Phase 1 investment limited to 6 sessions + ~54 spawns + ~200 items throughput foregone. If ROI not achieved by mid-Phase 2 (~254 items), escalate to human steward for continuation decision.
risks.governance_trigger: BF-010 (consumption rate) <50% at S830 → reporting pillar failed. Any single BF metric <20% improved → Phase 2 HOLD_BACK.

risks.title: Quality Board Dual-Run Disagreement >5%
risks.description: The Quality Board consolidates 3 v1 boards (Technical, DQS, EQS). If the consolidated board produces different quality verdicts than the v1 boards would have produced, the discrepancy rate may exceed the 5% tolerance threshold.
risks.v1_impact: v1 boards had de facto disagreement handled by ad-hoc agent re-spawning — no measurement of inter-board consistency.
s202_mitigation: Dual-run calibration: for the first 3 certification waves post-S830, run BOTH v1-equivalent boards AND v2 Quality Board on the same item batch. Compare verdicts.

Discrepancy tolerance: ≤5% disagreement rate (different CAQS dimension scores >1 point) → v2 board adopted. >5% → escalate to 6-board model temporarily (Quality Board split into Technical + Psychometric + Structural as separate boards).
Per-dimension score comparison: even if overall verdict agrees, individual CAQS dimension scores must agree within ±1 point for >95% of items.

Discrepancy root-cause analysis: if disagreement >5%, determine which dimension(s) produce divergent scores. Isolate whether the divergence is from consolidation (fewer eyes → lower quality) or from v1 inconsistency (different boards gave different scores to same items).

Board member calibration: Quality Board Agent 1 and Agent 2 receive same training data (50 calibration items with known-good dimension scores). Scores must match calibration key within ±1 across all dimensions before operational use.
risks.governance_trigger: If dual-run disagreement >5% for any certification wave, Quality Board split to 6-board model until root cause resolved. Session Arbiter triggers the escalation.

risks.title: Concurrent Session Conflicts During Transition
risks.description: During Phase 1 transition (S202-S207), some sessions operate on v1 tools and some on v2 tools. Concurrent sessions may: (a) write to the same pack file from different methodologies, (b) produce conflicting hash baselines, (c) create registry/delta ledger inconsistencies.
risks.v1_impact: DL-019 (432 items overwritten 2026-07-23). DL-028 (~200 slots overwritten 2026-07-23). Both occurred during methodology transition periods.
s202_mitigation: File-lock protocol deployed at S202 start — BEFORE any v2 tool writes. Covers ALL pack files, all scored_cases files, CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json, and DELTA_LEDGER.json.
Session registry: Governance Board maintains ACTIVE_SESSION_REGISTRY.md tracking which sessions are active, which files they have locked, and their v1/v2 methodology version.
v1/v2 coexistence: during Phase 1, v1 tools are read-only. All writes use v2 methodology. v1 tools that need writes are routed through v2 write gate.

Baseline freeze: at S202 T0, finalize CURRENT_BASELINES.md v1 hashes. v2 hashes are computed from S202 pack state and stored in v2 baseline section. Concurrent sessions compare against their era's baseline.
Transition window is time-bounded: Phase 1 ends at S207. All sessions from S208 onward operate exclusively on v2 methodology. No perpetual coexistence.
risks.governance_trigger: Any file hash change detected outside active session scope → RT-011 escalation (concurrent-write detection). Any session trying to write to a locked file → Session Arbiter REJECT with lock-holder session ID.
